title: Take care of the Earth
text: Miss Li: Every year, people in many countries turn off their lights for an hour. Do you know this activity?
Wang Bing: Yes, it's Earth Hour. It tells people to save electricity.
Miss Li: That's right. Earth Hour is on the last Saturday of March. It lasts from 8:30 to 9:30 in the evening. Will you take part?
Yang Ling: Yes, I will. It'll be great to help the Earth.
